about: The matrix of direction probabilities pi_ij (row above column) for the six sites (score A) and the simulated league (teaching posterior at the frozen draw, computed with the engine). Six-site cells, in the hidden data table and as in-cell labels, are rows of the base-R oracle (oracle-pairwise directionMatrix-six-scoreA, which equals 1 - pr_tutorial$one$e of postrank 1.1.0); the league's cells come from oracle-pairwise directionMatrix-league-seed20261030-prior.15, and its posterior means and SDs from oracle-simulate normalPosterior rows at prior SD .15 and .05. The six posterior means and the common SD, the C-D gap in SDs and the mirror values also come from v1's frozen registry. The list of least certain pairs takes its pairs and their orientation from oracle-v3 leastCertainPairs rows (six sites k 3, league k 10) and checks each row's probability against the directionMatrix oracle. Port to v3 1.13: v1's eight cases with prior_sd renamed priorSd (v3 preset keys are plain words) and the caption in its v3 wording; the list added to six-mean, league-label and league-mean; new cases for the cell key (the imprecise preset, a key in lower case, a cell of the other data set, a pick that survives a change of order, a change of data set, a diagonal cell). Not covered by expectations (data-num only): the distance of a cell from the diagonal (no golden or oracle row holds the league's display positions; the read-out's clause around it is checked as words), the league at prior SD .10 of the preset imprecise (no golden or oracle row yet), the legend cut points (CONFIG design constants) and the density axis ticks.
